criteria.text: Telemetry sampler caches a latest snapshot, samples on a configurable interval, and supports forced refresh.
Memory, disk/docker, GPU, and thermal collectors degrade gracefully by omitting unavailable sections.
Kind 10100 content includes resources, accelerators when present, and telemetry.
Kind 10100 publishing mines monotonic same-second created_at values.
Queue depth changes on job queue and terminal job cleanup trigger immediate republish, with post-job telemetry refresh.
TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS, TELEMETRY_DISK_PATH, and ADVERTISEMENT_INTERVAL_MS are configurable.
